q1.question: How does Anvil get the best rate?
q1.answer: Anvil queries multiple DEX aggregators in parallel, compares all quotes, and automatically selects the best rate considering both output amount and gas costs.

q2.question: Is my wallet safe?
q2.answer: Yes. Anvil is non-custodial, meaning you always control your assets. We never have access to your private keys. Transactions require your explicit approval in your wallet.

q3.question: What happens if the price moves during the swap?
q3.answer: Anvil uses slippage protection (default 1%). If the price moves more than the slippage tolerance, the transaction automatically reverts and your funds are safe.

q4.question: Can I swap any token?
q4.answer: Anvil supports 100+ major tokens. If a token has sufficient liquidity on supported DEXs, you can swap it. Exotic tokens may not be available.

q5.question: How long does a swap take?
q5.answer: Most swaps execute in 10-30 seconds. Hyperliquid swaps are sub-second. Time depends on blockchain confirmation speed and network congestion.
